Should any force majeure circumstance arise, buyer/ seller shall b e excused for non-fulfilment of contractual obligation, if the affected party, within 5 days of its occurrence, inform other party in writing. Force Majeure shall mean floods, natural di sasters for other acts, that are unanticipated or unforeseeable, and not brought about at t he instance of the party claiming to be affected by such event, or which, if anticipated or f oreseeable, could not be avoided or provided for, and which has caused the non performa nce or delay in performance, such as war, turmoil, strikes, sabotage, explosions, quaranti ne, restriction beyond the control of either party.
